name: Biomedical Sciences
about: Four years of life sciences on top of the pre-med courses US medical schools ask for: biology, chemistry, physics and calculus, then anatomy, genetics, immunity and pharmacology, ending in a research thesis. Gives a US degree and a UK Open University degree.

name: International Relations and European Affairs
about: Four years on how the international system works, from IR theory and foreign policy to European security, with research methods, ethics and an internship placed in an international organization.

name: Music Performance
about: Four years of academic music study built around performance: research, evaluation and weekly performance labs, with European music at the centre. Open to applicants who pass an audition.

name: Eastern Mediterranean Studies. Archaeology, History, Culture
about: Interdisciplinary study of the cultures of the eastern Mediterranean from prehistory to the Byzantine and medieval periods, through archaeology, history and classical literature, taught in English in Rhodes.

name: International Business and Technology
about: Four-year BSc (240 ECTS) taught entirely in English: management, accounting, economics, statistics, AI and data analytics in years 1-2, then a Management, Leadership and Strategy or a Technology and Analytics stream, plus an internship.

name: Clean Energy Science and Engineering
about: Clean-energy technologies studied through chemistry, physics, engineering design and sustainability, run jointly by three AUTh schools, with laboratory work and modelling throughout (240 ECTS).

name: Materials Science and Engineering
about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS, EQF level 7) in materials science and engineering: core sciences, laboratory training, advanced specialisation and a two-semester research thesis.

name: Environmental Sciences and Engineering
about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS) co-designed by five AUTh schools: physics, chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering and agriculture applied to climate, water, energy and ecosystems, ending in a thesis.

name: Sustainable Agriculture and Food Science
about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS) from the Agriculture and Chemistry schools: plant and animal production, food chemistry and technology, specialisms in year four and a research thesis. First cohort September 2027.

name: Sport and Exercise Sciences for Health and Performance
about: Four-year BSc (240 ECTS) in sport and exercise science, with laboratory teaching from the first semester: anatomy, physiology, biomechanics and training science, then one of two pathways in year four.

name: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.)
about: Four-year LL.B. (240 ECTS) taught in English in the civil-law tradition, with a common-law elective track and courses in European, international, digital and maritime law.

name: Medicine (English-taught Medical Degree)
about: Six-year medical degree in English (360 ECTS) for students who did their final school years abroad: clinical skills from the first semester, hospital rotations from year four, full-time clinical training in the last year.

name: Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece
about: Greek antiquity through archaeology, ancient history and Greek and Latin literature, taught in English in Athens with classes at museums and archaeological sites and field trips (240 ECTS).

name: Medicine (English-taught Medical Degree)
about: Six-year medical degree in English: five pre-clinical semesters, clinical courses, then full-time clinical practice in university departments at 16 Athens hospitals (360 ECTS).

name: Integrated Master in Pharmacy (MPharm)
about: Five-year integrated master's in Pharmacy taught in English for international students: eight semesters of theory and laboratory courses, then a practice and thesis year (300 ECTS).

name: International Program in Medicine
about: Six-year medical programme taught and examined in English: basic and pre-clinical cycles, then clinical clerkships from semester 9, with Greek lessons to B2 level so you can talk to patients.

name: English Medical Studies Program
about: Six-year medical degree in English (360 ECTS): four preclinical semesters with clinical skills in simulation, clinical semesters 5 to 10, then clinical practice at the Patras University General Hospital, with Greek lessons in the first six semesters.

name: Mechanical Engineering (Sligo)
about: Theory, practicals and workshops in mechanical and manufacturing engineering, with CAD/CAM, automation, 3D printing and CNC facilities, ethics and sustainability, and a work placement in year 3, semester 2.

name: Fine Art (Sligo)
about: Drawing, painting, digital media, photography and video, ceramics, printmaking and sculpture, building your own artistic practice through research and self-directed work in a new creative teaching hub with dedicated studios.

name: Computer Science
about: Algorithms, software engineering, cloud computing, networks and systems architecture, with machine learning and cybersecurity later on, plus a paid six-month INTRA work placement in year 3.

name: Actuarial Mathematics
about: Calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics and computing in years 1 and 2, then applied methods for insurance, finance and banking; year 3 is an eight-month paid INTRA placement.

name: Journalism
about: Reporting and writing for digital, social, print and broadcast, with media law, ethics and the politics and society you report on; radio and television studios, mock news days and a mandatory eight-week media placement.

name: Medicine
about: Six years of medicine, or five with two sciences at HL 5: scientific principles with clinical practice, case-based learning, simulation and placements across hospital and community settings.

name: Engineering (Undenominated)
about: One shared first year across civil, mechanical, biomedical, electronic and energy engineering, then you transfer into your chosen branch. An integrated five-year BE and ME, with a paid work placement built in.

name: Marine Science
about: Marine biology, earth science, chemistry, physics, oceanography and statistics, with field work from year 2 and dedicated time on the national research vessel in the final year; study abroad in year 3.

name: Bachelor of Music
about: Performance, composition and academic study together, from Irish traditional music and plainchant to popular music and musical theatre, with individual tuition, ensembles and a major in performance, composition or musicology in the final year.

name: Bachelor of Engineering (Electronic Engineering)
about: Electronic engineering with problem-based learning projects every year, accredited by Engineers Ireland, and an optional ME stream in fourth year with six months of industry work, Erasmus or a research internship.

name: Bachelor of Science
about: Start with four subjects from eight, Mathematics among them, across Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematical Physics and more, then narrow to a specialised degree in later years.

name: Fine Art
about: A studio-based degree at MTU Crawford College of Art and Design covering painting, drawing, sculpture, print, photography, performance, sound, video and digital media, with your own creative development set in art history and critical thought.

name: Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering
about: Mechanical and manufacturing engineering taught together: product and process design, with augmented and virtual reality tools, blended classroom and hands-on learning, and a formal work placement across years 3 and 4.

name: Software Development
about: A four-year software degree on the Bishopstown campus in Cork, with a work placement from January of year 3 arranged countrywide, with a focus on Cork and Dublin employers.

name: First Year Art & Design (Common Entry)
about: A shared first year across art and design, after which you choose a degree in fine art (print, media, sculpture, painting), applied art or one of eight design areas.

name: Graphic Design / Moving Image Design
about: Direct entry to the School of Design, leading to a degree in Graphic Design or in Moving Image Design; an optional Studio+ placement year makes it four years.

name: Textiles, Jewellery & Objects
about: Direct entry leading to a degree in Textile & Surface Design or in Jewellery & Objects; an optional Studio+ placement year makes it four years.

name: Fine Art and Applied Art
about: Direct entry to Fine Art (Media, Painting, Print or Sculpture) or Applied Art (Ceramics & Glass, or Textile Art & Artefact).

name: Education and Design or Fine Art
about: A joint honours degree that pairs the full Design or Fine Art course with teacher education, qualifying you to teach art in secondary schools.

name: Fashion Design
about: Fashion design, taught through the design process as it applies to the fashion industry: from a personal visual language to a final-year collection, with an optional Studio+ placement year.

name: Product Design
about: Designing and making new physical objects and experiences; optional Studio+ placement year.

name: Visual Culture
about: The history and theory of contemporary art, design, film and digital culture, with study visits in Ireland and Europe and a final-year work placement.

name: Illustration
about: Drawing, printing, composition, narrative and sequence, with live competition briefs in the final year; optional Studio+ placement year.

name: Interaction Design
about: Designing digital interactions for apps, websites, products, services and user experience; optional Studio+ placement year.

name: Medicine
about: Direct-entry medical degree in Dublin city centre, five or six years: clinical and communication skills from week one, cadaveric anatomy, simulation, then hospital rotations. Six-year entry adds a foundation year.

name: Dentistry
about: Five-year Bachelor of Dental Surgery with supervised patient contact from Year 1, a simulated dental learning environment and community-based clinical teaching in RCSI's Dental Education Centres.

name: Pharmacy
about: Five-year integrated programme awarding a BSc (Hons) and an MPharm, with clinical skills from Year 1, prescribing built into the curriculum and teaching alongside future doctors and dentists.

name: Physiotherapy
about: Four-year BSc combining lectures, practical workshops and clinical simulation with over 1,000 hours of placement in hospitals and rehabilitation settings; you study alongside future doctors, dentists and pharmacists.

name: Advanced Therapeutic Technologies
about: Four-year science degree designed with biopharma companies: the drug lifecycle, advanced therapeutics, AI and data analytics, lab practicals and an eight-month work placement.

name: Veterinary Medicine
about: A new five-year veterinary degree in Waterford that moves from animal biology and welfare through disease diagnosis, clinical medicine and surgery to professional practice, with placements in small and large animal clinics and hospitals.

name: Pharmacy
about: A five-year integrated Master of Pharmacy in Waterford: drug formulation, pharmacology, patient care and professional ethics, with placements in community and hospital pharmacies and a research project in the final year.

name: Engineering (Common Entry, Waterford)
about: One first year to try Automation, Electrical, Electronic, Sustainable Civil and Sustainable Energy engineering, then you pick the honours degree that fits, with a new engineering building under construction in Waterford.

name: Medicine
about: Five years of medicine in Dublin: the biomedical sciences first, clinical training starting early through problem-based learning and small groups, then hospital placements as a member of the care team.

name: Engineering
about: Two common years of mathematics, physics, chemistry and computing, then a choice of six engineering disciplines; five years lead to a Masters, with a BAI honours degree as an optional exit.

name: Philosophy
about: Reason and argument applied to existence, value and society: metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, political philosophy and philosophy of mind, with room to specialise in the later years. A small intake of 20.

name: Architecture
about: Studio-based design projects for buildings in urban and rural settings, alongside the history and theory of architecture, environment, construction, digital communication and law. Two years of postgraduate experience lead to the RIAI professional exam.

name: Drama (Performance)
about: Acting technique, voice and language in performance including Shakespeare, physical skills through movement, singing, dance and combat, and drama facilitation, taught at TU Dublin Conservatory. A small intake of 20.

name: Medicine
about: Five years rooted in anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, with small-group, patient-centred teaching in listening, history-taking and clinical examination from the start, and a research project for every student in the final year.

name: Engineering
about: A common first year in maths, physics, chemistry and the four engineering branches, then your pathway: Civil, Structural and Environmental; Electrical and Electronic; Energy; or Process and Chemical. A five-year ME is optional.

name: Commerce
about: Business economics, law, management, marketing, information systems and statistics, with five majors to choose from in year 4 and a six-month internship or a semester abroad in year 3.

name: Engineering
about: One common first year across the engineering disciplines, then a free choice of specialisation: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronic, Chemical and Bioprocess, Biomedical and more. Accredited by Engineers Ireland, IChemE and IoM3.

name: Veterinary Medicine
about: Five years to become a vet: animal structure, function and welfare first, then disease, medicine and surgery, ending in clinical rotations in the UCD Veterinary Hospital, with 36 weeks of work placements along the way.

name: Actuarial and Financial Studies
about: Mathematics, statistics, economics and finance for a career managing risk in insurance, pensions and investment; year 3 is a professional work placement of at least six months.

name: Medicine (Undergraduate Entry)
about: An integrated six-year course for school-leavers: early patient contact and case-based learning, moving from a biomedical foundation to clinical placements, with Garda Vetting and fitness to practise checks.

name: Financial Mathematics
about: Maths, statistics and computing applied to business, finance and banking, for people who enjoy mathematics and want a career in finance.

name: Architecture
about: Drawing, model making, CAD and design thinking alongside environmental and structural engineering, in a hands-on course fully accredited by the Royal Institute of the Architects of Ireland, with a cooperative education placement.

name: Irish Music
about: Artistic development and the academic study of Irish traditional music, with performance at the heart of it, taught in the Irish World Academy building, plus a period of cooperative education.

name: Accounting
about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) in financial and managerial accounting, auditing, taxation and accounting information systems; a base for CPA, ACCA or CMA qualifications.

name: Business Administration
about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) on the functional areas of business: economics, accounting, finance, management, operations, marketing and business ethics, after a broad general education.

name: Business and Finance
about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) combining accounting, economics, marketing and management with a focus on financial theory and practice, for business, banking, investment or consulting.

name: Civil Engineering
about: Four-year degree (268 ECTS) in designing, maintaining and operating infrastructure: transport, water supply, wastewater, flood control and buildings, with sustainability and resilience.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Four-year degree (272 ECTS) applying solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics and energy systems to design, analysis and manufacturing across aerospace, automotive and biomedical fields.

name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
about: Four-year degree (256 ECTS) in electronics, telecommunications, digital systems and signal processing, with hands-on work on 5G, IoT and embedded systems.

name: Industrial Engineering
about: Four-year degree (266 ECTS) on improving systems: process design, optimisation, modelling and simulation, production planning, engineering management and supply chains.

name: Software Engineering
about: Programming, software design and computing principles, then industry methods and tools for large-scale systems, with data processing and AI. Four years full-time (240 ECTS); a six-year part-time route exists.

name: Game Development
about: Four-year full-time degree (240 ECTS) in game programming, covering computer science and computer graphics for the games industry.

name: Graphic Design and Animation
about: Professionally oriented four-year degree (237 ECTS): visual art and design foundations, graphic design and visual communication, and 2D and 3D animation.

name: BA in Management
about: Three-year business degree (180 ECTS) covering business and management building blocks plus marketing, accounting and finance, data analysis, economics and entrepreneurship, through problem-based learning.

name: BA in Marketing
about: Management studies with a focus on marketing management, digital and social media marketing and marketing intelligence, for careers in the public and private sectors (180 ECTS).

name: BA in Management with Human Resources
about: General management plus human resource management, taught through interactive lectures, case discussions, workshops and role-plays; leads to HR and talent roles (180 ECTS).

name: BA in Management with Psychology
about: General management with a specialisation in psychology, taught interactively, for work psychology, HR and recruitment roles (180 ECTS).

name: BA in Tourism and Events Management
about: Tourism, events and the wider environment: how to evaluate and manage tourism and stage events in host destinations (180 ECTS).

name: BA in Accounting and Finance
about: Accounting and finance theory and practice, taught by practising professionals, to improve decision-making on real-world issues (180 ECTS); the page says it is eligible for the Get Qualified scheme.

name: BA Information Technology for Business
about: How organisations collect, process, store and use digital information, alongside business, marketing, accounting, data analysis and entrepreneurship (180 ECTS).

name: International Hospitality Management (Hons) with Specialisations
about: Hotel operations, marketing, accounting and digital technology, with placements and a semester at Haaga-Helia in Finland; in the final year you choose finance, human resources, spa and wellness, or food and beverage and events.

name: Diving Safety Management (Full-Time)
about: Diving science, medical aspects of diving, occupational health and safety, law and emergency response, with certified dive courses, placements and a dissertation; run with DAN Europe and delivered in a blended format.

name: Marine Engineering
about: Three years on how the engines and machinery of ships and marine installations are built, run and maintained, with emerging technologies, a work placement, and roles such as marine technologist or marine surveyor.

name: Cybersecurity
about: Three years on securing software, computer systems and networks: open-source operating systems, network security, digital forensics and offensive security, with work-based learning and an applied dissertation.

name: Game Art
about: Three years training digital artists for game production: art and design principles plus game-creation software, ending in a joint game project with Interactive Digital Media students.

name: Accounting and Finance
about: University of London degree developed by LSE academics (180 ECTS), covering the major issues of modern finance and accounting in theory and practice; SMI teaches it in person and UoL sets the exams.

name: Business Administration
about: University of London degree with academic direction from Royal Holloway: general business administration or a pathway in International Business or Marketing (SMI lists both pathways as degrees), taught in person at a teaching centre.

name: Computer Science
about: University of London degree in programming, mathematics and computing with a specialism such as machine learning and AI, games development or virtual reality; SMI lists these as separate degrees.

name: Doctor of Medicine and Surgery
about: Five years in two parts: two pre-clinical years with dissection labs, then three clinical years on hospital wards. After year 2 you can take a year out for a BSc (Hons) in Medical Sciences before year 3.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Four years of mechanics, thermofluids, materials and design, ending in an engineering project. By the end of year 2 you choose a stream: applied materials, applied mechanics and thermofluids, or industrial and manufacturing.

name: Information Technology (Artificial Intelligence)
about: Three years of computer science plus intelligent systems: knowledge management, natural language processing, game AI, web intelligence, adaptive and autonomous systems, and advanced user interfaces, with industry skills throughout.
